remaining_receipt_or_prompt_risks: The source-end state does not have a dedicated place for material user beliefs or conditional inferences that are not part of the action plan and are not established facts.
A compact reader can still omit explicit negative facts such as 'no deadline stated' even when the receipt has a dedicated field.
The graph section needs a reader-facing distinction between exact non-graph lineage, exact graph lineage, indirect exposure, and causal contribution.
Exact operability numbers can disappear during compact reconstruction even when their evidence scope survives.
A typed reconstruction validates shape, not faithful emphasis or complete recovery.
prospective_repairs_not_applied_to_this_: In the next receipt version, consider a bounded source-end stated-beliefs-or-inferences array with source references and evidence status; do not infer or score beliefs deterministically.
In the next reader contract, require an explicit deadline status value even when no deadline is stated.
In the next reader contract, require separate exact_non_graph_lineage and exact_graph_lineage fields rather than one ambiguous exact_lineage field.
Require exact call, cost, and scoped-token figures in operability reconstruction when present.

The remaining omissions and lineage compression are material enough to block a complete or self-evident transfer claim.
